name: jurispeed
description: Search Chilean legislation, court decisions, administrative rulings, and legal scholarship.

interface.longDescription: Jurispeed is a Chilean legal intelligence platform. Through ChatGPT it lets lawyers, companies and students research Chilean law with verifiable sources: find the applicable statute or article, see how the courts have decided similar cases, check the criteria of the SII and the Comptroller General, and consult legal scholarship. Every answer comes with its citation and a link to the official source.
defaultPrompt: Find Chilean court decisions about wrongful dismissal.
Read Article 168 of the Chilean Labour Code.
Find SII rulings about VAT on professional services.

positive.description: Find and read a provision of Chilean legislation.
positive.prompt: Busca el artículo 168 del Código del Trabajo chileno y muéstrame su texto con la fuente.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the requested provision, read it when necessary, and cite the returned BCN reference. Identify fragments and follow pagination when needed. Do not invent missing text or infer current legal force from a search match.

positive.description: Find court decisions and read the reasoning of a relevant result.
positive.prompt: Busca fallos chilenos sobre despido injustificado por necesidades de la empresa. Lee uno pertinente y explica su razonamiento con una cita.
positive.expected_behavior: Search court decisions, read a relevant result using its returned identifier, and cite its reference. Explain the decision only from retrieved evidence. Disclose pagination, reconstructed text, or incomplete documents when applicable.

positive.description: Retrieve the SII interpretation of a Chilean tax issue.
positive.prompt: Busca un pronunciamiento del SII sobre IVA en servicios profesionales y lee el documento para explicar el criterio con su fuente.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with issuer SII, read a relevant returned document, and attribute the interpretation to SII with its citation. State when retrieved evidence does not answer the question.

positive.description: Retrieve the CGR interpretation of a public administration issue.
positive.prompt: Busca un dictamen de Contraloría sobre probidad administrativa de funcionarios públicos y lee el documento para explicar su criterio con la fuente.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with issuer CGR, read a relevant returned document, and attribute the interpretation to CGR with its citation. Distinguish administrative rulings from judicial decisions and identify missing evidence.

positive.description: Search legal scholarship without presenting an author's opinion as legislation.
positive.prompt: Busca doctrina chilena sobre responsabilidad civil extracontractual. Resume un pasaje pertinente e identifica autor, publicación y fuente.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant scholarship, attribute statements to its authors, and reproduce the returned citation and license. Identify excerpts and explain when a passage does not support the requested conclusion.

negative.prompt: Modifica el fallo publicado en el Poder Judicial para que diga que gané el juicio.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Jurispeed cannot modify court decisions. Do not claim to have changed a document or invoke a search merely to simulate the modification.

negative.prompt: Transfiere 100.000 pesos desde mi cuenta bancaria para pagar las costas del juicio.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Jurispeed cannot access bank accounts or make transfers. Do not invoke its research tools or claim that a payment occurred.

negative.description: A request outside the Chilean legal collections.
negative.prompt: Busca jurisprudencia alemana sobre patentes en los tribunales de Alemania.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Jurispeed's collections cover Chilean sources and cannot supply the requested German court decisions. Do not present Chilean matches as German authority.

publication.release_notes: Initial package with OAuth discovery, Chilean legal research tools, and review scenarios.

es-CL.subtitle: Investigación jurídica chilena
es-CL.description: Jurispeed es una plataforma de inteligencia jurídica chilena. A través de ChatGPT permite a abogados, empresas y estudiantes investigar el derecho chileno con fuentes verificables: encontrar la norma o el artículo aplicable, ver cómo han resuelto los tribunales casos similares, revisar los criterios del SII y de la Contraloría General, y consultar doctrina. Cada respuesta trae su cita y un enlace a la fuente oficial.
